examples.chicago: Community area context is area context, not parcel/building certification.
examples.london: TOID generalized points are context points, not exact building polygons.
examples.nyc: Accepted footprint overlap can support building/parcel spatial evidence only where the accepted gate proves it.

hard_boundaries: A location confidence in one flow does not automatically certify another flow.
A generalized point is not a parcel/building polygon.
A nearby relationship is not an affected-asset certification.

location_confidence.A: authoritative/exact enough for the flow purpose
